Card Q&A.a: It refers to when there are 2 or more cards with the same level among all of the stacked cards.  Examples include when a level 5 Digimon has a level 5 digivolution card or when a level 6 Digimon has 2 level 5 digivolution cards.
Card Q&A.q: What does "if this Digimon's stack has 2 or more same-level cards" mean, exactly?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -4000 DP for the turn.

[When Attacking] If this Digimon's stack has 2 or more same-level cards, it may digivolve into an [Angel], [Holy Dragon], [Three Great Angels], [NSp] or [VB] trait Digimon card in the hand with the cost reduced by 2.
Inherited Effect: ＜Decode (Lv.4 or lower w/[Holy Beast]/[NSp]/[VB] trait)＞ (When this Digimon would leave the battle area other than in battle, you may play 1 specified Digimon card from its digivolution cards without paying the cost.)
Special Digivolution Condition: [DNA Digivolve] Yellow/blue Lv.4 + green/black Lv.4: Cost 0
